name: Haldex Generation 5 AWD coupling controller (MQB)

read_methods.notes: VW_Flash supports diagnostic programming. OpenHaldex documents the connector for CAN diagnostics. A board-level debug read is reported for 0CQ 907 554 D.

notes: Fifth-generation Haldex on MQB AWD cars (pump/kit part prefix 0CQ). OpenTune's haldex checksum (per-block 16-bit word-sum) is synthetic/vector-validated only. These are the pins of the in-line harness plug that mates with the Haldex controller, as documented by the OpenHaldex project (single source).

bench.notes: Terminal 30 on 3, terminal 15 on 1, ground 2, Haldex CAN-H 6 / CAN-L 5 (OpenHaldex).
bench.resistor_notes: Termination of the Haldex CAN segment is not documented; measure the resistance between CAN-H and CAN-L on the unit first.

safety_note: Bench safety: use a current-limited bench supply (12-13.8 V, start with a low current limit) and a fuse in the +12 V lead; connect ground first. Confirm every pin with a multimeter on YOUR unit before applying power - ground pins should show continuity to each other (and usually the housing), and hardware revisions can differ from the sources. A CAN bus needs about 60 ohm between CAN-H and CAN-L (two 120 ohm terminations): add a 120 ohm resistor if neither the unit nor your interface terminates. Swapped CAN-H/CAN-L just gives timeouts; +12 V on a signal pin can destroy the unit.

obd.notes: VW_Flash supports programming the Gen5 controller, and a separate forum report confirms flashing over OBD. OpenHaldex reads live measurements. The cited sources do not demonstrate a complete original flash read through the vehicle socket.

bench.how: On the Haldex-side 1J0973713 connector, pin 3 is permanent +12 V, pin 1 is ignition +12 V, pin 2 is ground, pin 6 is CAN-H and pin 5 is CAN-L. OpenHaldex lists no K-line on this plug and documents live measurements over CAN. A complete connector-only bench read is undocumented.

boot.mcu_mode: XC2000-family on-chip debug access (reported on 0CQ 907 554 D).

points.name: Board debug interface
points.note: The contributor reports connecting a MiniWiggler. The successful pin assignment is unconfirmed.

boot.notes: One contributor reports detecting the processor with a debug probe and reading the flash of 0CQ 907 554 D. The report does not establish reset timing or applicability to other 0CQ revisions.

security.notes: The Haldex writer calls the shared UDS programming routine, which requests security access before writing. The sources do not establish the requirement for a complete diagnostic read. OpenTune ships no OEM key.
